data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 晨曦微光中的元气依恋温存
data.description: 清晨金辉洒在白被单上。小麦色的健康美腿与你交缠，短发微乱的烧盐柠檬像只晒饱太阳的小鹿般，把脸深深埋在你的胸口，带着幸福的甜笑抱紧你不放，咕哝着不想起床。
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with bright white sheets
data.action: tangled in morning sheets, bare tanned shoulders exposed, hugging partner chest tight with affectionate nuzzling and a sleepy radiant smile
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunshine warming bare skin and white sheets
data.mood: morning newlywed warmth, sweet possessive girlfriend clinginess, blissful domestic peace
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets with bare tanned shoulders, Lemon Yakishio nuzzles partner chest tightly with a sleepy blissful smile in golden morning light.
data.animaCaption: Lemon Yakishio nuzzling partner chest in sunny morning sheets.
